text:
Movie Surfers | Behind the Scenes of Moana @MichelleKhare
The Movie Surfers are back for another episode, with “Moana.” Take a stroll down the beaches of Oahu with Dwayne Johnson (Maui) and learn what it means to bring his character of Maui to life in live action. Afterwards, Michelle Khare (@MichelleKhare) hops in the car for a road trip with Catherine Laga’aia (Moana) as they break down what it was like to step into the shoes of such a storied character and take a ride on Maui’s boat. Finally, the Surfers are joined by the movie’s choreographer, Tiana Liufau, to get a lesson in hula.

Watch Disney “Moana” only in theaters on July 10.  Get tickets now:
https://www.fandango.com/moana-2026-243429/movie-overview

Disney’s “Movie Surfers” goes behind the scenes of Disney’s newest movies, giving fans access to exclusive interviews, red carpets, set tours, and more. The Surfers dive into the magic to discover what it takes to bring our favorite movies to life. Originally aired in 1998 on Disney Channel, the Movie Surfers are back and catching all new waves, bringing fans along for the ride. 

Subscribe to the Disney YouTube channel for new #MovieSurfers episodes coming soon. 

In “Moana,” Disney’s live-action reimagining of the beloved animated film, Moana (Catherine Lagaʻaia) journeys beyond her island with the demigod Maui (Dwayne Johnson) to restore prosperity to her people. Directed by Thomas Kail and featuring original songs by Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foaʻi, and Mark Mancina, the film opens exclusively in theaters on July 10, 2026.
